name: flower_field
description: Parametric flower field / bedding (花海/花境): ground layer (grass, dirt-path lanes optional) + flowers at y+1 with deterministic per-column hash. Color schemes: single (单色), stripes (条带, band_width rows per color), gradient (渐变, palette sweeps the width), meadow (混色撒点). density controls coverage; edge_fade thins the border band so the field feathers out (边缘收束) instead of ending hard; tall flowers (sunflower/lilac/rose_bush/peony) emit both halves.
when_to_use: Park flower beds, meadow drifts around builds, roadside ribbon planting, garden color blocks. origin = min corner, y = the GROUND layer (the script lays its own grass/path ground at y and flowers at y+1 — place y on top of the terrain surface or run terraform_pad first). For small formal beds use scheme=single/stripes with edge_fade=0; for wild meadows use meadow + gap_fill=grass.
use_for: 公园花坛/路边花带/郊野花海/庭院色块;条带花境(stripes)、渐变花坡(gradient)、野花草甸(meadow)

origin.notes: 最小角;y = 地面层(花在 y+1)

scheme.notes: 单色/条带/渐变/混色撒点

flowers.notes: 调色板,顺序即条带/渐变顺序;暖色组 poppy+red_tulip+orange_tulip,粉白组 pink_tulip+white_tulip+oxeye_daisy+azure_bluet

path.notes: 小径穿插:cross=十字穿心,grid=每 4 格一条

edge_fade.notes: 边缘收束带宽度,带内密度 x0.25;规整花坛设 0

ground_material.notes: 地面;花盆栽床可用 podzol/coarse_dirt

gap_fill.notes: 空格补 short_grass(草甸感)还是留空(规整花坛)

pitfalls: 花在 y+1,地面在 y:origin 的 y 必须落在地表,垫高了整片花悬空,埋低了花被土吞
高花(sunflower/lilac/rose_bush/peony)是两格方块,脚本自动补上半;别把高花配进低矮镶边(压在树下/屋檐下会穿模)
density 1.0 + gap_fill=none 是纯花地毯,近看呆板;草甸务必 0.4-0.6 + gap_fill=grass
渐变/条带方向固定(gradient 沿 x 扫色,stripes 沿 z 成行);想换方向就换 origin/width/depth 的朝向,不要手改输出
path 格子不种花且地面换 path_material;cross 在偶数宽度时偏左半格,属于正常
别混用超过 5 种花——GrabCraft 语料里好看的公园花坛都是 2-4 种成组
example: python patterns/flower_field.py --params '{"origin":[100,64,100],"width":16,"depth":12,"scheme":"stripes","flowers":["minecraft:red_tulip","minecraft:orange_tulip","minecraft:white_tulip"],"path":"cross"}' --out field.json && python patterns/flower_field.py --params '{"origin":[140,64,100],"width":20,"depth":20,"scheme":"meadow","density":0.5,"edge_fade":2}' --out meadow.json
